title: Checkout subtotal ignores quantities
kicker: Ridgeline Outfitters · checkout bug, before and after
note: Recorded from the example checkout page with sample cart data. Before shows the bug; After shows the same cart with the fix.

shot.title: Checkout subtotal ignores quantities
shot.body: Lena's three-line cart is under-billed on the payment step. First the bug, then the same cart after the fix.

shot.title: Before: the bug
shot.body: Lena's cart on the current build. Watch the subtotal and total against the line prices.

shot.title: Three lines, six items
shot.body: Trail Runner ×1, Merino socks ×3 and a cap ×2. Each line's price already shows price × quantity.

shot.title: Subtotal reads {{ #subtotal }}
shot.body: The lines add up to $222.00. The subtotal counts each line once and drops the ×3 and the ×2.

shot.title: Total reads {{ #total }}
shot.body: Tax is 10% of the wrong subtotal, so the error compounds. Lena is charged {{ #total }} for a $252.20 order.

shot.title: What actually happened
shot.body: ✗ subtotal() sums unit prices, not price × quantity. ✗ Tax is derived from that figure. Net: every multi-quantity order is under-billed.

shot.title: After: the fix
shot.body: The same cart on the fixed build. One line changed: each line now contributes price × quantity.

shot.title: Subtotal reads {{ #subtotal }}
shot.body: Same cart, same prices. Each line now contributes price × quantity: $120 + $54 + $48.

shot.title: Total reads {{ #total }}
shot.body: Tax follows the corrected subtotal and shipping is unchanged. Lena pays what the cart shows.
